accepted.quote: H.R. 2462, the ``Black Vulture Relief Act of 2025,'' is an unnecessary piece of legislation that would undermine the Migratory Bird Treaty Act and violate our treaty obligations with Mexico by removing federal protections from black vultures.
accepted.bill: H.R. 2462 Black Vulture Relief Act of 2025
accepted.rationale: The legislator opposes removing federal protections from black vultures, indicating strong support for maintaining wildlife protections under the Migratory Bird Treaty Act.
